en.p: Two points P, Q on the four sides of the square ABCD with vertices $\mathrm{A}(2,\,0)$, $\mathrm{B}(0,\,2)$, $\mathrm{C}(-2,\,0)$, $\mathrm{D}(0,\,-2)$ in the coordinate plane satisfy the following conditions.

For the point $\mathrm{R}(4,\,4)$, let $M$ and $m$ be the maximum and minimum values of $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{RP}}\cdot\overrightarrow{\mathrm{RQ}}$, respectively. Find the value of $M+m$. (Here O is the origin.) [4 points]
